description: "The Philosophy of Earthquakes, Natural and Religious" by William Stukeley is a scientific publication written in the mid-18th century. This work explores the nature of earthquakes from both philosophical and theological perspectives, attempting to understand their causes and meanings beyond mere physical phenomena.
